user.title: Add Tion account
user.description: Sign in with the Tion account used in the MagicAir app. Home Assistant then opens a captcha page, and Tion e-mails you a confirmation code.

data_description.email: Email address of the Tion account.
data_description.password: Tion account password. It is only used to sign in and is not stored.

captcha.title: Captcha
captcha.description: Complete the check on the page opened in a new window. Home Assistant continues automatically when it is done.

code.title: Confirmation code
code.description: Tion has sent a confirmation code to {email}. Enter it to finish signing in.

data_description.code: The code from the Tion e-mail.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to Tion again
reauth_confirm.description: The Tion session for {email} has ended; it lasts at most 30 days. Enter the password to sign in again; a captcha and an e-mail code follow.

data_description.password: Current password for this Tion account.

abort.already_configured: This Tion account is already configured.
abort.already_in_progress: A Tion login for this account is already in progress.
abort.reauth_successful: Signed in to Tion again. The integration has been reloaded.
abort.wrong_account: This sign-in belongs to a different Tion account than the configured one.
abort.password_not_set: This Tion account has no permanent password. Set one in the Tion MagicAir app and try again.

error.invalid_captcha: The captcha was not accepted or has expired. Submit the form to try again.
error.code_expired: The confirmation code has expired. Submit the form to get a new one.

init.title: Tion options
init.description: Choose what to configure. Option changes are saved only when you return to this step and select Done.

data_description.options_action: Open local PID settings, configure speed presets, or select Done to save all pending option changes.

local_pid.title: Local CO2 PID
local_pid.description: Choose the breezer to set up local PID for.

data_description.breezer_guid: The breezer that gets the «PID» fan mode driven by an external CO2 sensor from Home Assistant.

local_pid_menu.title: Local PID — {breezer}
local_pid_menu.description: CO2 sensor: {sensor}. Changes apply after Done on the main options step.

breezer.title: Configure local PID
breezer.description: The default PID coefficients are recommended for typical setups. Change them only if you understand PID tuning. Saving this form returns to the local PID menu; use Done on the main options step to apply changes.

data_description.pid_enabled: Adds the Local PID fan mode and PID presets to this breezer.
data_description.co2_sensor_entity_id: Required when enabled. Select a Home Assistant sensor with CO2 device class and a numeric ppm value.
data_description.pid_interval: How often local PID recalculates the fan speed. Default: 60 seconds.
data_description.pid_base_output: Baseline output in percent before PID correction. Default: 20. Keep the default unless the breezer under-ventilates near the target.
data_description.pid_kp: Default: 0.5. Higher values react more strongly to the current CO2 error.
data_description.pid_ki: Default: 0.001. Integral gain accumulates long-running error; increase carefully to avoid overshoot.
data_description.pid_kd: Default: 0.0. Usually leave this at 0 because CO2 sensors often produce noisy derivative signals.

presets.title: Speed presets
presets.description: Choose the breezer whose presets to change.

data_description.breezer_guid: The breezer whose climate presets to change.

presets_menu.title: Presets — {breezer}
presets_menu.description: Presets: {count}. Changes apply after Done on the main options step.

preset_add.title: Add preset
preset_add.description: Choose a Home Assistant preset name and how it should control this breezer. To change a preset type later, remove it and add it again.

data_description.preset_name: Preset name to expose on this breezer climate entity.
data_description.type: Manual stores one fixed fan speed; Local PID stores the speed limits local PID keeps to while the preset is active (offered only when local PID is set up for the breezer).

preset_config.title: Configure preset {preset_name}
preset_config.description: Set the speeds for this preset. Available speed range is limited by the selected breezer model.

data_description.min_speed: Lower speed limit of local PID while the preset is active.
data_description.max_speed: Upper speed limit of local PID while the preset is active. It cannot be lower than the minimum speed.
data_description.speed: Fixed fan speed used when the Manual preset is active.

preset_edit.title: Edit preset
preset_edit.description: Select an existing preset to edit its speed values. The preset type cannot be changed here.

data_description.preset_name: Preset whose speed values should be edited.

preset_remove.title: Remove preset
preset_remove.description: Select a preset to remove from this breezer. Removal is saved after the final Done on the main options step.

data_description.preset_name: Preset that should be removed from this breezer.

error.min_above_max: Minimum speed must not be greater than maximum speed
error.no_breezers: The account has no breezers, or the integration is not loaded yet

auth_failed.message: Tion rejected the saved sign-in; sign in to the account again.

cloud_error.message: The Tion cloud returned an error: {message}

speed_limits_invalid.message: The minimum speed cannot exceed the maximum speed
